usedFor: SimpleCert holds the certificates and recipients, and Brevo receives each recipient through “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Recipient Added” in SimpleCert, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A new recipient is a person to reach, so they join a Brevo list.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” works on existing contacts, so the recipient must already exist in Brevo.
